answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the pearl of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lagoon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the plume of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
